title: Harmonic Security Raises $50 Million for Workforce AI Protection
key_facts: Harmonic Security announced a $50 million Series B round, bringing total funding to $76 million.
Crosspoint Capital Partners led the round, with existing investors also taking part.
Founded in 2023 by Alastair Paterson (CEO) and Bryan Woolgar-O'Neil (CTO), who earlier founded Digital Shadows, later acquired by ReliaQuest.
The platform secures employees' AI tools: browser-based AI, desktop AI and agentic workflows.
It uses small language models to read each AI interaction in context and apply controls.
Money goes to engineering and go-to-market hiring in the US and UK.
quote_evidence: Workforce AI security startup Harmonic Security today announced raising $50 million in a Series B funding round that brings the total raised by the company to $76 million.
The fresh investment round was led by Crosspoint Capital Partners, with additional support from existing investors.
why_it_matters_hint: Investors are funding tools that control how staff use AI at work.
notes: Company announcement relayed by SecurityWeek; no independent view of the product.
